tool_input.description: Make invoice counter atomic, check shared state in collaborators, run checkout tests 5 times

result:
- **Cause:** A real race in `CheckoutService.Checkout`: `_nextInvoiceNumber++` is not atomic, so two parallel checkouts can get the same invoice number (63 distinct instead of 64). The bug predates this MR, which only moved the line. Xping marks the test "known flaky" with the same error on 6 machines and CI, so it is not specific to runner-02.
- **Action:** Code fix in `src/Storefront/Checkout/CheckoutService.cs`: the counter is now `_lastInvoiceNumber`, incremented with `Interlocked.Increment`. Numbering still starts at 00001. The test is unchanged.

The 7 `CheckoutServiceTests` pass locally; I did not run the full suite. The change is not committed or pushed, so the pipeline won't go green until you push it.
